abstract.t: This document specifies the Human Conversational Turn-Taking Protocol (HCTTP), an integrated session-layer communication protocol for multi-node human spoken interaction. HCTTP formalizes connection establishment (Three-Way Handshake), token arbitration, turn transitions, real-time backchannel signaling (ACK/NACK), dynamic rate adaptation, conversational padding (filler frames), collision recovery, and standardized conversational status codes over shared acoustic channels.
